newsitem.title: USA: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-CARDINALS RE-SIGN RB LARRY CENTERS.
newsitem.headline: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-CARDINALS RE-SIGN RB LARRY CENTERS.

text.p: Larry Centres, the top pass-catching running back in the National Football League, has decided to remain with the Arizona Cardinals.
Centres, considered one of the top prizes in this year's free agent market, agreed to a three-year contract with the Cardinals, the team announced.
Centres, 28, who has a total of 200 receptions over the last two seasons, was aggressively pursued by the New York Giants, who are now coached by Arizona's former offensive coordinator Jim Fassel.

The two-time Pro Bowl selection, became the first running back to crack the 100-reception mark when he had 101 catches for 962 yards in 1995. The previous record of 92 catches was set by San Francisco's Roger Craig in 1985.
Centres followed that with 99 receptions for 766 yards last season. Since 1993, Centres has caught more passes (343) than any running back in the NFL.
He has not enjoyed the same level of success running the football. Last season, he rushed for a career-high 425 yards on 116 carries, a 3.7 yards-per-carry average.
